name: liteon
description: Lite-On is a leading provider of optoelectronics, power management, and electronic components for automotive, consumer, and industrial applications.
longDescription: Lite-On Technology Corporation, founded in 1975, is a global leader in optoelectronic components, power management solutions, and electronic manufacturing services. With decades of innovation, Lite-On provides high-quality LEDs, optical sensors, power supplies, and automotive electronics to customers worldwide. The company is committed to green technology and sustainable development, offering energy-efficient solutions for smart cities, automotive electronics, and industrial automation.

faqs.question: What are Lite-On's core product categories?
faqs.answer: Lite-On specializes in four main product categories: LED Components (automotive, display, and general lighting LEDs), Optocouplers (isolation solutions for industrial and automotive), Power Management (AC-DC and DC-DC converters), and Optical Sensors (proximity, ambient light, and gesture sensors). Each category offers industry-leading performance and reliability.
faqs.decisionGuide: Choose LED Components for lighting applications, Optocouplers for isolation needs, Power Management for power conversion, and Optical Sensors for detection applications.

faqs.question: Does Lite-On provide automotive-grade components?
faqs.answer: Yes, Lite-On offers extensive automotive-grade products certified to AEC-Q100 and AEC-Q101 standards. These include automotive LEDs for interior and exterior lighting, optocouplers for EV and hybrid systems, and power management solutions for automotive electronics. All automotive products undergo rigorous testing for temperature, vibration, and reliability.
faqs.decisionGuide: For automotive applications, select products with AEC-Q certification. Contact our FAE team for automotive design support and qualification assistance.

faqs.question: How does Lite-On compare to other optoelectronics manufacturers?
faqs.answer: Lite-On is one of the world's largest optoelectronics manufacturers with significant advantages: (1) Vertical integration from chip to module, (2) Mass production capability ensuring consistent quality and competitive pricing, (3) Strong R&D investment with thousands of patents, (4) Global manufacturing footprint for supply security, (5) Comprehensive automotive certification portfolio. Compared to competitors, Lite-On offers excellent value with proven reliability.
faqs.decisionGuide: Choose Lite-On for high-volume applications requiring consistent quality and competitive pricing. For specialized niche applications, evaluate alternatives.

faqs.question: What technical support does BeiLuo Electronics provide for Lite-On products?
faqs.answer: BeiLuo Electronics provides comprehensive technical support for Lite-On products: (1) Application engineering support for LED driver design, optocoupler selection, and power supply design; (2) Optical simulation and thermal analysis services; (3) Reference designs and evaluation kits; (4) Failure analysis and reliability testing coordination; (5) Custom solution development support. Our FAE team has extensive experience with Lite-On products.
faqs.decisionGuide: Contact our FAE team early in the design phase for optimal component selection. Request reference designs for faster time-to-market.

faqs.question: What is the typical lead time for Lite-On products?
faqs.answer: Standard lead time for Lite-On products is 8-12 weeks for standard products. BeiLuo Electronics maintains strategic inventory for popular Lite-On products, enabling 1-3 day delivery for sample quantities and common part numbers. For high-volume production, we offer scheduled delivery programs with guaranteed allocation. Custom products may require additional lead time for qualification.
faqs.decisionGuide: Plan for 8-12 weeks lead time for production orders. Check our local stock for immediate prototyping needs. Contact sales for high-volume scheduling.

faqs.question: Does Lite-On offer customization services?
faqs.answer: Yes, Lite-On offers various customization options including: (1) Custom LED binning and color matching for display applications, (2) Special package configurations for space-constrained designs, (3) Modified electrical specifications for specific applications, (4) Custom labeling and traceability requirements. Customization requires minimum order quantities and may involve NRE charges. Lead time for custom products is typically 16-20 weeks.
faqs.decisionGuide: For standard applications, use off-the-shelf products. For custom requirements, contact our sales team to discuss MOQ and NRE requirements.

faqs.question: What quality certifications does Lite-On maintain?
faqs.answer: Lite-On maintains comprehensive quality certifications including: ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), IATF 16949 (Automotive Quality), AEC-Q100 (Automotive ICs), and AEC-Q101 (Automotive Discrete). Manufacturing facilities are regularly audited by major automotive OEMs. Product reliability data including FIT rates and MTBF are available upon request.
faqs.decisionGuide: Lite-On certifications meet requirements for most industrial and automotive applications. Contact us for specific certification documentation.
